name: 04 - Dispute Letter Generation
description: Generates FCRA-compliant dispute letters per bureau via Claude, lints each draft for banned phrases and statute citations, saves as pending_review or flags for manual rewrite.

parameters.query:
SELECT ni.item_id, ni.case_id, ni.bureau, ni.creditor,
       ni.account_number_masked, ni.item_type, ni.dispute_basis,
       ni.fcra_sections, ni.rationale, c.first_name, c.last_name,
       c.street, c.city, c.state, c.zip, c.ssn_last4,
       COALESCE(c.current_round, 1) AS round
FROM negative_items ni
JOIN cases c ON c.case_id = ni.case_id
WHERE ni.case_id = '{{ $json.case_id }}' AND ni.analysis_status = 'disputable';

parameters.jsCode:
const d = $input.first().json;
const today = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-US', {month:'long',day:'numeric',year:'numeric'});
const consumer = d.consumer || {};
const bureauAddresses = {
  experian:   'Experian
P.O. Box 4500
Allen, TX 75013',
  transunion: 'TransUnion LLC
Consumer Dispute Center
P.O. Box 2000
Chester, PA 19016',
  equifax:    'Equifax Information Services LLC
P.O. Box 740256
Atlanta, GA 30374'
};

const roundGuide = {
  1: 'Round 1 — Factual dispute under 15 U.S.C. § 1681i(a). Clearly state which items are inaccurate, incomplete, or unverifiable. Request deletion or correction. Bureau has 30 days to investigate.',
  2: 'Round 2 — Method of Verification demand under 15 U.S.C. § 1681i(a)(7). The bureau has failed to adequately verify. Demand the specific name, address, and phone of furnisher contacted and the procedure used. Reference Gorman v. Wolpoff & Abramson LLP (9th Cir. 2009).',
  3: 'Round 3 — Escalation citing § 1681s-2(b) and § 1681n. Bureau has failed after two rounds. Threaten litigation citing Safeco Insurance Co. of America v. Burr, 551 U.S. 47 (2007) for willful noncompliance.'
};

const system = [
  'You are a senior FCRA dispute specialist drafting a professional dispute letter on behalf of a consumer.',
  'The letter must:',
  '(1) Be factually grounded — only assert what the data supports;',
  '(2) Cite specific FCRA statutes by full section number (e.g., 15 U.S.C. § 1681i(a)(1));',
  '(3) Use professional, firm language appropriate for certified mail;',
  '(4) Include the specific items being disputed with creditor name and account type;',
  '(5) State the specific remedy requested (delete, correct, or verify);',
  '(6) Include a deadline (30 days per § 1681i) and consequences (right to sue under § 1681n or § 1681o);',
  '(7) NEVER guarantee outcomes, promise score increases, or use banned phrases.',
  'Output ONLY the letter body text (no salutation header — that will be added). Start with "I am writing to formally dispute..."'
].join(' ');

const user = [
  (roundGuide[d.round] || roundGuide[1]),
  '',
  'Bureau: ' + d.bureau.toUpperCase() + ' — ' + (bureauAddresses[d.bureau] || 'Address on file'),
  'Consumer: ' + JSON.stringify(consumer),
  'Disputed items: ' + JSON.stringify(d.items, null, 2),
  '',
  'Draft a complete, professional FCRA dispute letter body. Include:',
  '- Opening statement identifying the consumer and purpose',
  '- Specific items to dispute with creditor names',
  '- The legal basis for each dispute (FCRA statute)',
  '- The specific remedy requested for each item',
  '- Deadline and litigation warning',
  '- Statement that this letter is sent via certified mail'
].join('
');

return [{ json: { ...d, anthropic_request: {
  model: 'claude-opus-4-7',
  max_tokens: 2048,
  system,
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: user }]
} } }];

const inp = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { ...inp, letter_body_safe: (inp.letter_body || '').replace(/'/g, "''"), item_ids_json: JSON.stringify(inp.item_ids || []), lint_violations_json: JSON.stringify(inp.lint_violations || []) } }];

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO dispute_letters (case_id, bureau, round, letter_body, item_ids, letter_status, created_at)
VALUES ('{{ $json.case_id }}', '{{ $json.bureau }}', {{ $json.round }},
  '{{ $json.letter_body_safe }}', '{{ $json.item_ids_json }}'::jsonb, 'pending_review', now())
RETURNING letter_id;

INSERT INTO dispute_letters (case_id, bureau, round, letter_body, item_ids, letter_status, lint_violations, created_at)
VALUES ('{{ $json.case_id }}', '{{ $json.bureau }}', {{ $json.round }},
  '{{ $json.letter_body_safe }}', '{{ $json.item_ids_json }}'::jsonb, 'needs_rewrite',
  '{{ $json.lint_violations_json }}'::jsonb, now())
RETURNING letter_id;
